raw.description:
Real people. Real service.

At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of Generosity, Respect, Innovation, Teamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

Through an Employer of Record (EOR), we are looking for a new Technical Product Manager in India to join our growing Product Team. This individual will report into our Product Management Team Lead and drive product launches for customer-facing solutions that enhance brand loyalty, retention, and revenue across our website and app. If you have strong technical expertise, a strategic vision, and a passion for collaborating with cross-functional teams to champion customer-centric solutions, we’d love to hear from you!

Role Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote from India

Schedule: Monday through Friday with a minimum schedule overlap of 4-5 hours per day with 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time to ensure effective collaboration

Base Salary: $37,000 - $46,000 USD per year

Responsibilities:

  • Manage complex system integrations by overseeing third-party integrations. Understand how data flows between systems and ensure changes to one part of the platform do not create downstream issues in another.
  • Evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on business impact, technical complexity, and resource availability, helping prioritize work against larger project and business goals.
  • Collaborate on the strategy, discovery, and execution of initiatives involving complex system integrations, enhancements, and customer-facing features.
  • Own the product backlog: create detailed, technically sound user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation within JIRA and Confluence.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies such as standups, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, ensuring the team delivers high-quality solutions on time.
  • Balance technical debt, new capabilities, and operational improvements.
  • Actively manage timelines and deliverables, focusing on interactions within and across departments; collaborate with key stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met.
  • Collaborate closely with developers to define technical requirements, ensuring feasibility and alignment with business objectives.
  • Act as a translator between business and technical stakeholders, clarifying business needs while advocating for technical best practices.
  • Lead UAT planning and execution to ensure product quality across projects and releases.
  • Support end-to-end testing, QA, and validation for technical implementations and system integrations.
  • Establish metrics for key projects and ensure monitoring plans support business goals; analyze product performance and resolve technical issues post-launch.
  • Effectively communicate complex insights and outcomes to stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Translate technical concepts into clear, actionable language for non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, QA, Finance, Operations, Customer Service, and Marketing, adapting your communication style to the audience and ensure all teams are aligned on priorities and impact.
  • Identify and communicate problems affecting the team and proactively propose and implement solutions.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the end-to-end order lifecycle, including payments, inventory, fulfilment, shipping, and returns and ensure platform decisions reflect the operational and financial impact of changes across the business.
  • Work with data to validate outcomes Use data tools (SQL, BigQuery, or similar) to validate requirements, verify outcomes, and support evidence-based decision making. Comfortable creating, reading and interpreting API specs, technical documentation, and system diagrams.
  • Use AI tools in a product context, whether for product discovery, troubleshooting system issues, analyzing data, or accelerating day-to-day workflows.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in one of the following or associated majors: Business, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 6+ years of professional experience with 3+ years in a product or technical role focused on software development and system integrations in an eCommerce setting with a proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives on time and within scope, while demonstrating good judgment in resolving escalated and complex issues.
  • Demonstrated Agile development mindset with hands-on expertise in JIRA, Confluence, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • A natural curiosity for AI tools and demonstrated experience using them in a product context, whether for product discovery, troubleshooting system issues, analyzing data, or accelerating day-to-day workflows.
  • Hands-on experience working with Developers and IT teams, including writing technical requirements and participating in technical discussions (e.g., APIs, data models, architecture).
  • Cloud deployment experience with one or more major platforms such as Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure.
  • Ability to work on assignments of diverse and complex scope, identifying solutions to unfamiliar problems with minimal guidance.
  • Awareness of how monolith and microservice systems coexist and impact each other and an appreciation of how platform changes impact customer experience, operations, and finance.
  • Established effective working relationships with senior leadership both internally and externally.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Understanding of full stack development technologies and frameworks, including JavaScript, React, Node.js, Java, Spring Boot, or similar.
  • Familiarity with enterprise systems such as Warehouse Management Systems, ERP, CRM, or similar platforms, and experience integrating these systems.
  • Certified CSPO, SAFe, or other relevant product/technical certifications, plus Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional, Azure Fundamentals).

Why work with us: 

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options
    • Competitive Provident Fund contributions
    • Paid time off and holidays
    • Mental health support and wellbeing program
    • Company-provided equipment and one-time $250 USD work from home stipend
    • $750 USD annual professional development budget
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance – We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives!
  • We support growth – We strive to innovate every day. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide potential for career growth through our hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, opportunities for internal mobility, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for DE&I organizations, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at https://www.supplyhouse.com/our-company!

Additional Details: 

  • Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations.
  • SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer, strongly values inclusion, and encourages individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position.
  • To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.
  • We are committed to providing a safe and secure work environment and conduct thorough background checks on all potential employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
  • All emails from the SupplyHouse team will only be sent from an @supplyhouse.com email address. Please exercise caution if you receive an email from an alternate domain.

Medical Excellence Lead

Overview
IQVIA is currently seeking a Medical Excellence lead, who will report into the leader of our Content & Engagement division within the IQVIA Technology Enabled Services' US business line. This is a pivotal position expected to drive step change performance by setting tangible strategy and leading execution across a diverse set of products and services.

The Medical Excellence Lead will own a portfolio spanning a suite of medical consulting and technology-enabled services that together drive measurable medical affairs outcomes. The portfolio currently exceeds $20M in annual revenue, with success measured by Revenue and EBITDA performance versus plan, year-over-year growth, customer satisfaction, and retention. Equally critical to this role is the ability to collaborate and influence cross functional product and engineering teams who build and operate the tech platforms in this portfolio, aligning roadmaps and delivery with medical use cases and client needs.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Client Engagement & Business Development:Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client executives, positioning IQVIA as a strategic partner. Generate new business through senior-level meetings and presentations, oversee strategic proposals, and contribute to thought leadership via speaking engagements, client meetings, and publications. Continuously train and enable the go-to-market (GTM) community on the offering suite to strengthen connectivity with the broader IQVIA portfolio.
  • Operational Leadership: Develop and drive a comprehensive operational plan to achieve financial and strategic objectives across the portfolio, translating strategy into execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Innovation & Growth:Champion the adoption of AI within the Medical Excellence portfolio to create differentiated offerings, accelerate client value, and improve delivery efficiency, while assessing new potential technologies for Medical Strategy and evidence planning use cases.
  • Cross Functional Collaboration & Influence:Foster a culture of collaboration across Product, Tech, Data Science, Sales, and Consulting teams; align stakeholders across complex organizations including global and regional technology teams to execute technology roadmaps and delivery models that serve medical affairs use cases, even without formal reporting relationships.
  • Team Leadership:Inspire and lead high performing teams of technology, product, and consulting experts; mentor and elevate capabilities to deliver world class solutions and measurable client impact.

Portfolio Offering Area Expectations

  • Medical Strategy:Shape and scale Medical Strategy and Integrated Evidence Planning offerings; assess opportunities for growth and enhancement; evaluate AI/technology usage; refine pricing and delivery models to meet diverse client needs.
  • Expert Ecosystem:Evaluate positioning for sustained growth of Expert Ecosystem, a leading expert identification technology; ensure offerings are integrated with the broader IQVIA portfolio and support enterprise wide growth and client outcomes.
  • Expert Engagement Platform: Lead the positioning and uptake of the newly launched Expert engagement platform as the central technology supporting engagement orchestration and performance tracking for medical affairs teams. Integrate with the broader IQVIA portfolio and delivery models.
  • Medical Impact:Create and refine the Medical Impact technology development roadmap based on client use cases and feedback, oversee specifications, collaborate with tech and data teams, and implement delivery and pricing models (e.g., self service, insights packages, consultative approaches) with integration to IQVIA’s broader solutions.

Key Skills and Experience

  • Proven Team Leadership across diverse consulting and technology teams, with a track record of client satisfaction and business success.
  • Strategic Acumen to craft and execute strategies that anticipate market dynamics and client needs, grounded in robust analytics.
  • Subject Matter Expertise in medical affairs including expert identification, expert engagement, medical strategy, and medical impact; familiarity with AI/GenAI applications in medical affairs.
  • P&L Management & Business Development, including revenue tracking/forecasting and opportunity identification.
  • Healthcare Data & RWD Analytics—in depth understanding of real world data and its use in impact measurement analytics.
  • Leadership in Complex Organizations, with demonstrated results aligning stakeholders without formal reporting lines.
  • Executive Presence & Communication skills for C suite engagement, presentations, workshops, and compelling storylines/business cases.

Competencies

  • Leadership: Sets clear vision, inspires teams, drives transformational change.
  • Collaboration: Builds strong internal/external partnerships to achieve shared
  • Communication: Conveys complex ideas with clarity and impact.
  • Innovation: Champions new technologies and approaches to deliver solutions.
  • Customer Focus: Places clients at the center of decision making.
  • Results Orientation: Maintains relentless focus on financial and operational targets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced medical, scientific, and/or technology degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical/healthcare industry, with a proven track record of delivering against targets.
  • 10+ years of experience managing technology processes or offerings in pharma/healthcare consulting; medical affairs experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated business development, strategic thinking, and consultative skills; ability to manage complex relationships and priorities.

raw.description:
Position: Director of Supply Chain
Department: Supply Chain & Logistics
Employer Company: EAK Distribution
Reports To: COO / Integrator
Job Type: Full Time, Remote
Salary: Up to $4000
Work Hours: 8 AM - 12 PM EST, with flexibility to coordinate with external partners in PST and occasional communication with Chinese suppliers.

Role (Overview of the Position)

The Director of Supply Chain is a senior leadership role responsible for building and managing the end-to-end supply chain infrastructure that will scale HOME GROWN from ~$20M to $100M+ in revenue. This position owns the full physical flow of goods: raw material procurement (domestic and international), vendor management including overseas finished goods suppliers, production coordination with Heirloom Organics, inventory planning and demand forecasting, inbound/outbound logistics, and multi-channel fulfillment across Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop (MCF and FBT), Shopify, Home Depot dropship, and future retail partners.

Reporting to the COO/Integrator, the Director of Supply Chain leads the logistics team, owns the supply chain budget, and serves as the primary driver of ERP selection and implementation. This role must build the systems, processes, and team capable of supporting 600+ SKUs within two years while maintaining a stockout rate below 1%.

This is not a maintenance role. The company is in a high-growth phase with expanding channels, a vertically integrated manufacturing facility, and plans to 5x revenue. The Director of Supply Chain must be someone who has built supply chain infrastructure at scale and thrives in environments where the playbook has not been written yet.

Responsibilities (Tasks Associated with the Role)

Demand Planning & Inventory Strategy

  • Own the demand planning function across all channels and all SKUs (180 today, scaling to 600+ within two years).
  • Build and maintain rolling demand forecasts that integrate sales velocity, seasonality, promotional calendars, and channel expansion timelines.
  • Maintain a stockout rate below 1% across all active SKUs while minimizing overstock and dead inventory.
  • Establish safety stock models, reorder points, and lead time buffers for each product category and channel.

  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Brand Management, and

    Product Development to align forecasts with planned launches, promotions, and channel expansions.

Procurement & Vendor Management

  • Consolidate and own all procurement across entities: raw seeds (via Heirloom Organics), envelopes, mylars, soil, pots, packaging materials, and finished goods from overseas and domestic suppliers.
  • Manage international supplier relationships including overseas finished goods vendors: lead times, import logistics, customs/duties, and quality assurance.
  • Negotiate supplier contracts, pricing, lead times, and quality standards.
  • Build a diversified vendor base that reduces single-source risk as SKU count scales.
  • Manage purchase order workflows and ensure alignment between procurement spend and approved budgets.

Heirloom Organics Production Coordination

  • Serve as the primary supply chain interface with Mark (Operations Lead) and the Heirloom Organics team in Grants Pass, OR.
  • Translate demand forecasts into production requirements and ensure production schedules align with fulfillment timelines.
  • Track production output against commitments. Escalate and problem-solve when production falls behind plan.
  • Collaborate on capacity planning as SKU count and volume grow, including equipment utilization (seed counters, bag packers, labeling lines).

Logistics & Fulfillment

  • Oversee all inbound freight (vendor to warehouse/FBA/FBT) and outbound fulfillment operations.
  • Manage Amazon FBA compliance: IPI score maintenance (450+), restock limits, stranded inventory resolution, shipment plan optimization.
  • Manage TikTok Shop fulfillment across both Amazon MCF and Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT), including inventory allocation to TikTok warehouses.
  • Optimize B2C direct-to-consumer fulfillment for Shopify and TikTok orders. Determine when orders should ship from 3PL, Heirloom Organics directly, or FBA/FBT. Specifically optimize multi-unit order fulfillment to reduce per-unit shipping costs.
  • Oversee Home Depot dropship fulfillment and future retail channel logistics.

  • Optimize freight costs, carrier relationships, and shipping workflows.

  • Manage 3PL relationships and evaluate when direct fulfillment from HO is more cost-effective.

ERP Selection & Implementation

  • Lead the supply chain workstream of ERP evaluation and selection (currently in evaluation phase).
  • Define requirements for inventory management, procurement, production planning, and order management modules.
  • Own the supply chain side of ERP implementation: data migration, workflow configuration, team training, and go-live execution.
  • Ensure the ERP delivers real-time inventory visibility across all entities and channels.

Budget & Cost Management

  • Own the full supply chain budget: freight, raw materials, packaging, 3PL costs, and logistics overhead.

  • Track spend against budget with no more than +/-5% variance.

  • Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities across freight, procurement, and fulfillment without compromising service levels.
  • Report on supply chain unit economics and COGS trends to the COO and Controller.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Directly manage Asad (Logistics Manager) and Faiqa (Logistics Analyst).
  • Provide oversight and evaluation of Ather (Logistics Coordinator) and Faisal to assess fit and readiness for scale.
  • Assess the current team structure and capabilities against the requirements of a 600+ SKU, $100M operation. Identify gaps and build a hiring plan.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with all direct reports. Establish clear KPIs and accountability for each role.
  • Foster a culture of operational discipline, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement.

Results (Expected Accomplishments)

Inventory & Availability

  • Maintain stockout rate below 1% across all active SKUs and channels.

  • Achieve demand forecast accuracy of 85%+ within the first 12 months.

  • Maintain Amazon IPI score at 450+ consistently.

  • Establish forward visibility of 8+ weeks on potential stockouts.

Procurement & Cost

  • Consolidate all procurement under a single function within the first 90 days.
  • Maintain or improve COGS as a percentage of revenue versus prior year.

  • Maintain supply chain budget within +/-5% variance.

Systems & Infrastructure

  • Complete ERP evaluation and selection within the first 90 days.

  • Lead supply chain ERP implementation to go-live.

  • Deliver real-time inventory visibility across all entities and channels.

Heirloom Organics Alignment

  • Establish a weekly production alignment cadence with Heirloom Organics within the first 30 days.
  • Achieve 90%+ production schedule adherence against demand-driven production plans.

Team & Operational Readiness

  • Complete a team assessment within 60 days: document capabilities, gaps, and a hiring/development plan for scaling to 600+ SKUs.
  • 100% of direct reports have documented roles (4R documents), clear KPIs, and weekly 1:1s.

As the data engine for IT and Security many of the biggest names in the most demanding industries trust Cribl to solve their most pressing data needs. Ready to do the best work of your career? Join the herd and unlock your opportunity.

This is a remote role based out of the United States

Why You'll Love This Role

Value Engineering is a consultative team that supports the Cribl sales and GTM organization and engages customers to explore the business value of Cribl. We deliver high-touch customer engagements while building content, frameworks, tools, processes and best practices to help sellers independently develop the business case for Cribl. In this highly cross-functional role, you'll collaborate with teams from sales, solutions engineering, product marketing, and customer success. Approximately 80% of your time will be focused on customer engagements and ~20% of your time will be working on broad GTM and value selling scale projects. Together, we'll drive value selling across the GTM organization, directly contributing to:

  1. Boosting win rates,
  2. Speeding up sales cycles,
  3. Reviving dormant opportunities,
  4. Increasing deal sizes, and
  5. Enhancing deal margins.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Engage, Consult and Influence: Partner with sales teams and customers, employing a value-based selling approach to create compelling narratives and business cases. You'll help the customer answer the 3 key questions: "Why change?", "Why Cribl?", and "Why now?"
  • Lead Discovery Sessions: Conduct technical value discovery sessions with senior executives and technical staff, asking questions and providing insights that help shape their business case for Cribl.

About True Environmental

True Environmental Holdings is a ~$200M environmental and engineering services platform with approximately 700 professionals across 32 offices in 26 states and Canada. Through a deliberate buy-and-build acquisition strategy, True has unified a family of high-performing firms — including Sundance Consultants, LLC (Sundance), Matrix, Ensero, Padre, GKY, Great Ecology, Sphere 3, and Triton — under a shared "One True" identity and culture. Our work spans environmental remediation, environmental compliance, natural and cultural resources, ecological services, water infrastructure, and federal program support. We are growing, and we grow with intention.

About Sundance

Sundance is True Environmental's primary federal services platform, with core competencies in Natural Resources, Cultural Resources, and Compliance, Site Characterization and Remediation. Sundance has built its reputation over decades on technical excellence, trusted client relationships — across the service branches of the Department of War (DoW), a diverse portfolio of federal civilian agencies, state and local governments, commercial clients and Tribal entities — and a strong small-business heritage. The firm is currently engaged in two successful SBA mentor-protégé joint ventures (8a and SB) as it navigates the transition from small to large business classification, and is now backed by the scale, capital, and cross-discipline capabilities of the broader True platform.

The Opportunity

True Environmental is seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial leader to serve as Federal Business Unit Lead for Sundance. This is a senior executive role with full accountability for the Sundance federal portfolio and direct responsibility for driving organic growth, strengthening client relationships, providing operational leadership and integrating Sundance's capabilities into the broader True platform.

The ideal candidate brings a successful track record of winning and executing federal environmental programs —— combined with the leadership presence and collaborative mindset to build something larger. This role sits at the intersection of operations, business development, and enterprise strategy, and reports directly to the CEO.

About Us

Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.

About the Role

Are you a Nurse Practitioner who thrives on connecting with patients and making a real difference in their health outcomes? Do you want to leave behind rigid, cookie-cutter systems and join a dynamic, patient-centered organization that values your creativity and clinical expertise? If you're passionate about improving outcomes at scale and energized by meaningful patient engagement, we want you on our team.

At Galileo, we're transforming healthcare by delivering personalized, comprehensive care to those who need it most — underserved patients and those with complex medical needs. We use technology, data, and operational rigor to drive outcomes, and we believe the clinicians doing this work are central to that mission. We're a digital-first medical group, and we're proud of the culture we've built: inclusive, collaborative, and deeply committed to health equity.

Galileo is looking for a culturally Nurse Practitioner to join our Population Health team. In this role, you will use phone and video-based care to provide high-quality, comprehensive follow-up care to patients who are post-hospital discharge.

Here's what you'll do:

  • Cover our care needs for our Transitions of Care program.
  • Day to day work includes telephonic outreach (“cold calls”) and scheduled video/phone visits for patients who have recently been hospitalized and discharged.
  • Visits focus on: Medication reconciliation, symptom screening, and ordering of any needed follow-up labs, medications or supplies.
  • You will also navigate conversations with patients to build trust, explain Galileo's care model and connect them to services.
  • Coordinate care across settings — hospital and ED transitions, pharmacies, and community providers — to keep patients connected and moving forward.
  • Collaborate with our nursing team
  • Be accountable to individual performance targets while contributing to team-level population health goals

How We Work

Galileo is a 24/7 medical group that provides high-quality, comprehensive primary care as well as transition of care follow-up. We work in 4-hour shifts (mornings, afternoons, evenings, overnight on weekdays and weekends). At 24+ hours you will be considered full-time and benefits eligible. Providers are expected to work weekends on a monthly basis, specific schedule will be influenced by total hours committed and patient care demands.

We are currently looking for a Nurse Practitioner with an active license in either MA and/or CT who is available to work 32-36 hours/week.

Compensation

$78/hour (regular rate) and $90/hour (premium rate)

About You

You're a people person. You love connecting with others and have an innate ability to build rapport quickly — even on a cold call. Your curiosity and creativity come through in every patient conversation, and you're looking for an environment where those instincts are an asset, not an afterthought.

We look for passionate clinicians who are invested in solving complex problems that impact millions of lives and excited about fixing what's broken to improve care quality and health outcomes for everyone. We believe in a culture that fosters teamwork, excellence, and sound decision-making — built on mutual respect and trust.

We would love to hear from you if you have the following or equivalent experience:

  • Certified Nurse Practitioner in Adult, Family or Geriatrics
  • Active state licensure in MA and/or CT, with the ability to obtain additional state licensures
  • 5+ years of post-graduate clinical experience in Primary Care or Geriatrics
  • 2 of those years may be substituted by time spent working at a Skilled-Nursing facility or Long Term Care facility
  • Direct experience engaging Medicare and Medicaid populations managing complex, comorbid conditions
  • Motivational interviewing skills you can draw on to help patients make meaningful behavioral changes
  • Comfort in a digital-first environment, with experience in or a genuine appetite for virtual care delivery
  • Solid tech proficiency; familiarity with Google Suite and Slack is a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish, including cultural fluency, is a strong bonus

How We Care for You

  • Flexible scheduling - design the schedule that works best for YOU
  • Competitive health, vision and dental plans
  • Company paid short and long term disability
  • 12 weeks paid parental leave
  • Malpractice insurance provided, including tail coverage
  • 401(k) with company match

How We Hire

Galileo Health is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

We have recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. We will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments or access to any financial accounts; and/or conduct text-only interviews. If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission.

  • Client & Internal Partner Collaboration: Work alongside sales and credit teams to structure deals, address underwriting inquiries, and support client needs. Act as a mentor to analysts, sharing expertise in financial analysis, credit structuring, and risk assessment.
  • Credit Knowledge Development: Stay informed on market trends, credit policies, and risk mitigation techniques to strengthen expertise in commercial lending.
  • Uses independent judgement and discretion to make decisions regarding assigned portfolio
  • Analyzes and resolves problems pertaining to the assigned portfolio.

  • Basic understanding of loan structuring and credit agreements.

Job Competencies:

Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.

Instacarts Catalog Content team powers the product information that customers, shoppers, retailers, and brands rely on across our marketplace. We ingest, enrich, and validate massive, ever-changing datasets so customers can discover, compare, and purchase with confidence. We are seeking a Director, Software Engineering to lead the next chapter of our “agentic catalog” strategy—building intelligent, autonomous systems that elevate quality, speed, and scale across the entire catalog lifecycle.

In this role, you will lead a multi-team organization and partner closely with Product, Machine Learning, Data Science, Design, Operations, and our Retail and Brand partners. You will define the technical strategy and operating model to deliver best-in-class catalog accuracy, coverage, and freshness—at scale. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and want to drive outsized impact on core customer experiences, this is the place to do your career-defining work.

This role is remote-friendly across the U.S. and Canada (in Ontario, BC, Alberta & Nova Scotia).

About the Job

  • Own the end-to-end technical strategy for an agentic catalog platform, combining distributed systems, data pipelines, and AI/ML-driven automation to ingest, normalize, enrich, and validate product content at scale.
  • Lead, organize, and scale a multi-team engineering organization of approximately 40+ total reports (including managers and senior ICs), setting clear goals, establishing robust operating mechanisms, and developing talent.
  • Deliver platform reliability and quality by setting and meeting availability, latency, and accuracy SLAs; mature on-call, incident response, observability, and data-quality guardrails.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, ML, Data Science, and Operations to prioritize roadmaps, run experiments, and ship features that improve discovery, search relevance, substitution quality, pricing accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
  • Drive build/buy decisions, vendor selection, and budget stewardship for key capabilities (e.g., vector search, embeddings, OCR, image understanding, and content moderation) while ensuring privacy, security, and brand safety.
  • Champion a culture of transparency, inclusion, and continuous improvement—aligning teams to clear outcomes, sharing progress openly, and celebrating wins that grow the pie for customers, shoppers, retailers, and brands.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 15+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating large-scale platforms or data-intensive systems.
  • 7+ years of experience leading engineering managers and multiple teams, with direct responsibility for organizations of 30+ engineers.
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale data pipelines and services (batch and streaming) in cloud environments (e.g., AWS or GCP), including event-driven architectures and microservices.
  • Demonstrated ownership of platform reliability and data quality with defined SLAs/SLOs, on-call practices, and incident management.
  • Track record shipping production systems that leverage ML/AI (e.g., LLMs, information retrieval, content understanding, or automated data enrichment) and integrating them into user-facing or platform workflows.
  • Experience hiring, coaching, and performance-managing engineering managers and senior engineers; building diverse, high-performing teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration experience with Product, Data Science/ML, and Operations to define roadmaps and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with e-commerce catalog systems, product taxonomy/ontology, data normalization, or content quality at marketplace scale.
  • Hands-on familiarity with GenAI and agentic frameworks (e.g., orchestration, tool-use, retrieval-augmented generation), vector databases/embeddings, and multimodal models (text, image, OCR).
  • Background in search/relevance, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or compliance workflows (e.g., nutrition, allergens, age-restricted items).
  • Demonstrated success leading platforms adopted by 100+ internal users or powering revenue-critical customer experiences.
  • Master’s degree or higher in a related technical field.
  • Experience managing vendor ecosystems and annual engineering budgets tied to infrastructure and third-party services.
  • Familiarity with experimentation and evaluation frameworks for content quality (e.g., offline/online metrics, A/B testing) and robust observability for data drift and model performance.

Job Title: FSP Principal Stat Programmer

Job Location: Minato-ku, Japan

Job Location Type: R1529817

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

【会社紹介・ビジョン】

私たちIQVIAは、ヒューマンデータサイエンスの先駆的な企業として、医療・ヘルスケアの前進に取り組む皆様をIQVIAならではの革新的なソリューションによってご支援することで、「誰もが、より健康に自分らしく生きられる社会」の実現を目指しています。世界最大規模を誇る医療・ヘルスケア関連データを基盤に、人・データ・サイエンスを融合させた見地から、未だ満たされない治療ニーズに応える、新たな医薬品や医療機器の開発と市販化、厳格化する規制やコンプライアンスへの対応、持続可能な医療システム推進の支援など、患者さんをはじめとするすべての人々のために、より良い未来へと医療・ヘルスケアを前進させていく力となることが、私たちの使命です。

世界100以上の国と地域で約9万人が活動するIQVIAの日本法人として、IQVIAジャパンでは約6,000人が一丸となり、この使命に向かって日々、力を尽くしています。

【ポジションについて】

FSPモデルになります。

G130～G150のスペシャリスト～管理職（部下なし）レベルを想定しております。（経験により最終的にオファーグレードを決定）

臨床試験（PhaseI～IV）におけるClinicalProgramming業務を

SAS、Python、SQL、Rといったプログラミング言語に加え、データ分析および可視化ツール（Spotfire、Tableau）を使用し、顧客の

SOPで業務を行います。

多部門との連携あり：クリニカルオペレーションチーム、顧客側の担当者など

【業務内容】

■基本ルール：顧客のSOPに従って仕事をする

■例外：SDTMだけは、当面IQVIAシステム、プロセスに従って対応

■将来：顧客側の新システム導入後は、SDTMも顧客のルールに統一

  • 治験立ち上げ時に必要な関連文書をのレビュー

  • 治験計画（プロトコル）とリスク対策を読み解き、

    データの設計ルールを文書化・管理

  • 技術仕様書

  • マッピング資料（aCRF含む）

  • データ転送契約書（DTA）などを作成・維持

  • クライアントのルールに基づくデータレビュー環境と、SDTM標準に準拠したデータセットを作成

  • Data ReviewModel（DRM）

  • SDTMデータセット

  • リスクベースド・モニタリングと継続的なデータ確認を支援

  • QTL（QualityTolerance Limits）、CtQ（Criticalto Quality）などを用いた

    臨床データ・安全性データの継続レビュー

  • 解析・報告のためのデータ確定作業

  • データカットやデータベースロック対応

  • 規制当局提出用データの作成・検証

【必須経験】

  • コンピュータサイエンス、またはその他の理系分野における学士号以上

  • 最低5年以上の関連業務経験

  • SASの知識・経験は必須

    PythonおよびSpotfireの経験があれば尚可

    SQL、Tableau、Rの知識があれば尚可

  • SDTMの知識理解

  • ライフサイエンス企業での経験（アカデミアも可）

  • チームで業務を進めた経験

  • リモートワークが可能

  • 英語スキル（読み書き必須、日常会話）

  • ネイティブレベルの日本語力

【尚可】

  • プログラマーチームのリードとして、

    試験（Trial）リードの経験が2年以上あること

    またはSAS、Python、Spotfire、R などを用いて、複数の臨床開発プログラムまたは特定の疾患領域（Therapeutic Area）にわたる、幅広いソリューション開発の経験が2年以上

※業務の指示は日本語になりますが、上長がグローバル。

面接時に通訳サポートの希望があればアサイン可能です。

【雇用形態・勤務時間・福利厚生・休日休暇】

  • 雇用形態：正社員／契約社員など

  • 勤務時間：9:00-17:30

  • フレックス勤務：あり

  • 在宅勤務制度：あり

    福利厚生：法定内（社会保険制度）・法定外（IQVIA独自制度）の両面から充実した福利厚生制度あり

  • 受動喫煙対策：あり

  • 休日休暇：年次有給休暇、夏季休暇、病気休暇、特別休暇、女性特別休暇、育児介護休暇、看護休暇·など

  • 試用期間：あり（通常６か月）

【給与・待遇】

  • 給与：当社規定により優遇します

  • 昇給：あり

  • 賞与：あり

  • 時間外手当：あり

【選考プロセス】

  • 書類選考→人事面談→部門面接（英語）

【応募方法】

日本語の履歴書、職務経歴書、英語のResumeをご準備ください。

Services Overview:

The services requested are for Clinical Programming deliverables for clinical trials Phase I – IV utilizing SAS, Python,SQL andR, data analytics, and visualization tools Spotfire and Tableau on client's systems.

ExperienceDeliverables:

  • Servicesrenderedwill adhere to applicable client's SOPs, WIs, policies, local regulatory requirementsexcept for SDTM deliverables, which will adhere to applicable IQVIA systems and processes until client's future clinical data platform is implemented, at which time client's SOP’s and processes will beadhered..

  • Review and provide input into all trial set-up documentation

  • Translate protocol and any applicable de-risking into the creation and maintenance of detailed technical specifications, mapping documentation includingaCRF, data transfer agreements, as applicable, etc.

  • Creation of Data Review Model (DRM) based on current client's standards and SDTM datasets based on current SDTM standards

  • Creation of back-end edit checks, listings,and visualizationsto support risk-based central monitoring, e.g., Quality Tolerance Limits (QTLs), Critical to Quality (CtQ), etc., and ongoing clinical and safety data review

  • QC of all clinical programming deliverables

  • Perform unblinding, data-cut activities for planned reporting milestones and database locks

  • Development and validation of electronic submission packages thatcomply withsubmission requirements from FDA, EMEA, and other regulatory agencies as needed.

  • Supportthedevelopmentofstandardsanddriveimplementationwithinthe organization

Primary interfaces:Provider Functional Manager, client's Point of Contact, Clinical Programmers, Clinical Trial Teams including but not limited to, data management, statistical programming, statisticians, central monitoring, clinical, and clinical data standards representatives.

raw.excerpt: Talent Acquisition is dedicated to ensuring that teams at our client have the people they need to achieve their goals.
raw.description:
Talent Acquisition is dedicated to ensuring that teams at our client have the people they need to achieve their goals. As a product-driven organization, we hire the people who build at our client, the people who support our users, and the people who tell our story in the market. All human progress comes down to teamwork—and we work with the entire company to enable teamwork by building our own team. We work as a team to get to know the whole person, to communicate our values, and to ensure that candidates are well-informed and delighted throughout the process. Recruiting is a company-wide effort and responsibility and we encourage all our team members to adopt the motto “Always Be Recruiting.”
We are looking for a new member of the Talent Acquisition team who will be responsible for creating a well organized, efficient, and enjoyable experience for candidates and interviewers. You will be empowered to work with candidates and our internal team to help structure the best possible interview and hiring experience.
This is an opportunity for detail-oriented, people-focused and collaborative individuals to dive into one of the most rewarding and impactful careers on earth - talent acquisition and recruiting. Everyday you create bottom-line impact for the organizations you support, and literally change people’s lives.

What you’ll achieve
• Coordinating high-volume of Domestic/ Global interviews; phone screens, video conferencing, Batch Days, presentations and onsite interviews with efficiency and accuracy
• Support pre/post-interview meetings and hosting duties
• Partner closely with Recruiters, Sourcers and Hiring Managers to provide a memorable and seamless experience for candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide updates to candidates regarding their applicant/interview status as needed
• Maintaining recruitment applicant tracking system, ensuring information is up-to-date
• Facilitate expense reimbursement process for candidates
• Coordinating reference checks
• Participate in and provide analytical support in design, development, and implementation of recruitment projects and programs (e.g. support referral bonus tracking).
• Collaborate with other team members to continuously improve and streamline processes (e.g. tracking candidate data or interview training)
• Multi-task and effectively prioritize and work in a dynamic, demanding environment
• Develop strong stakeholder relationships (Hiring Managers, Talent Acquisition, People and Workplace teams) and maintain effective communication channels.
• Represents and promotes our client to potential applicants by providing information and responding to questions.
• Handles and prioritizes multiple ranges of advanced administrative duties with wide latitude for independent judgment and initiative.

About you
• 1-2 years customer service experience
• Highly organized with the ability to prioritize multiple functions and tasks while managing time efficiently
• Demonstrated creative problem solving skills
• Proficient in Google Apps and other calendar/meeting applications
• Self-directed, detail-oriented problem solver with a strong desire to contribute
• Learn quickly in a fast paced, ever-changing environment
• Maintain a high level of confidentiality
• Strong team player that loves to bring new ideas to the table

Nice to Have
• Experience with Greenhouse ATS and Asana (for project management)
• Experience scheduling and supporting recruitment activity
• Event planning experience

The Purpose Driven Career Objectives of a [role]

This should explain, in summary, the general responsibilities and the key tasks of the role. This should also include their purpose, relationships with customers, co-workers, and others, and the results expected of incumbent employees.

As a 2D Artist, you will be responsible for working with the Producer and Lead Artist on the visual development of existing titles as well as new IP within the studio. You are expected to provide the teams with inspirational illustrations as well as production artwork, including; concept art on character designs, environment and object exploration, paint overs, storyboards, color, lighting compositions, graphical designs and layouts for webpages, marketing assets, and general PR materials. You will also be using your passion for great art to regularly suggest and drive improvements to the game, both visually and as a whole.

  • Can be listed in order of process or importance

Format: present participle

  • Example:

    • providing layered illustrations for storyboards, CG sequences, UI elements, online web comics, or game assets
    • mocking up in-game screens according to specifications set by the team leads

Your Success Profile includes:

  • Should list down skills, knowledge and/or behaviour

  • Can include areas of expertise

  • Indicate required educational background

  • Previous work experiences needed or preferred

  • Any technical skills required (i.e. Java Programming, iOS Applications Development)

Format: nouns and adjectives

  • Example:

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Backend Engineer at GitLab, you will help build the core capabilities of our dedicated software supply chain security Add-On. This commercial offering helps organizations control what software enters their builds, verify the integrity of what they ship, and identify malicious packages before they reach production. You will work across a set of connected backend systems that support package policy enforcement, artifact signing and verification, provenance attestation, and malicious package intelligence.

This is a founding role on a small team with a high level of responsibility. The engineering choices you make in API design, testing, performance, and security will help shape how this product grows. You will work closely with a Staff Backend Engineer on architecture and partner with other engineers to deliver secure, reliable features for enterprise customers with complex supply chain security needs. This role is well suited for someone who wants to combine solid Ruby on Rails backend skills with deep technical problems in security, platform design, and product development in GitLab's all-remote, asynchronous environment.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Building backend services for package policy enforcement and dependency control
  • Implementing artifact signing, verification, and provenance workflows using the Sigstore ecosystem

What you’ll do

  • Design and implement backend features across the Add-On's software supply chain security surface, including policy enforcement, artifact signing and verification, provenance attestation APIs, and malicious package detection integrations, delivering secure capabilities that meet enterprise customer requirements.
  • Build and improve the package policy evaluation engine, including rule compilation, request matching, enforcement decisions, and performance-sensitive execution paths tied to GitLab's Dependency Firewall infrastructure, improving accuracy, reliability, and execution performance.
  • Develop artifact signing and verification workflows, including Sigstore and Cosign integrations, signing key lifecycle management, keyless signing with OpenID Connect (OIDC), and policy-based promotion gates, enabling trusted and auditable software delivery.
  • Create and evolve the configuration interfaces that enterprise security teams use, including backend APIs and the GraphQL surface for expressing supply chain security requirements, improving usability and adoption for customer administrators.
  • Integrate Add-On capabilities with GitLab's existing security policy framework, including policy inheritance and policy-as-code support through YAML, expanding coverage across customer security workflows.
  • Collaborate with adjacent teams as malicious package intelligence is incorporated into the Add-On offering, helping deliver cohesive workflows and faster response to package risk.
  • Write and maintain comprehensive RSpec and integration test coverage, and help improve test reliability across the team, increasing confidence in releases and reducing regressions.
  • Review merge requests with a security-first mindset and implement solutions with substantial decision-making scope in partnership with the Staff Backend Engineer, maintaining code quality and secure engineering standards.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven backend engineering experience, including production Ruby on Rails expertise, as this is the team's primary language.
  • Working knowledge of Go or a clear willingness and ability to ramp up quickly in it.
  • Solid API design skills, including experience with REST, GraphQL, and defining clear internal service boundaries.
  • Solid PostgreSQL fundamentals, including schema design, query optimization, and indexing strategies.
  • Experience with Redis for caching and distributed coordination patterns.
  • A security-aware engineering mindset, with sound judgment around trust boundaries, input validation, and failure modes.
  • Familiarity with software supply chain security concepts such as Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts (SLSA), software bill of materials (SBOM), artifact signing, or related security scanning approaches.
  • Interest in complex policy, registry, or platform problems, including areas such as rules engines, package ecosystems, cryptographic signing, or DevSecOps product development.

About the team

The SSCS Add-On team is part of GitLab's Software Supply Chain Security stage and is focused on building a commercial offering that addresses real supply chain security challenges for enterprise customers. The team works on capabilities that combine multiple parts of the GitLab product into a more complete security solution for organizations with strong compliance and risk management needs.

The work is both technically interesting and strategically important. The team is building in a space shaped by fast-moving threats, evolving customer requirements, and close coordination with nearby teams across the broader security area. That combination creates an environment where engineers can contribute to product direction while solving practical backend challenges in a visible part of GitLab's platform. For more on how related teams work, see Team Handbook Page.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental leave
  • Home office support

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. At Netflix, we are shaping the future of global entertainment because we believe there is a better way to watch. Our members need our help from time to time, and that’s where our Global Customer Service (CS) organization focuses; on providing amazing interactions with our subscribers around the world. Our goal is excellence, simplicity, and getting our members back to streaming. Netflix is looking for a talented Content Designer with a strong technical background to join our Customer Service Content Strategy team and improve the support experience for our members and customer service agents.

The Customer Service Content Strategy team helps create and manage information that customers and agents need to support our customers. We focus on ensuring information is accurate, easily findable, easy to read, and on-brand for our customers and agents. As a Conversation Designer, you will work closely with content designers, program managers, visual designers, and cross-functional partners in product, engineering, and research, to design conversations for our virtual agent to ensure the best customer experience. This role owns how the virtual agent handles conversations such as how it processes context, structures dialog, manages pacing, and maintains a consistent voice across end-to-end journeys in multiple languages. The Conversation Designer combines the skills of conversation design, UX, and content strategy and will be setting conversation design standards and playbooks for our virtual agent in a scalable way. We are seeking a customer-obsessed, data-driven, highly technical individual with experience building chatbots and voice assistants, with experience in prompt design, human-in-the-loop AI evaluations, and creation of golden datasets to train conversational models. Excellent communication skills, project management, and cross-functional collaboration are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Design human-AI multi-turn conversations across chat and voice, including intent modeling, dialogue flows, interaction patterns, and error handling that provide a delightful customer experience.

  • Help craft prompts and agentic interaction patterns that shape model reasoning, clarification, recovery, escalation, and handoffs. Define logic, routing rules, and agent boundaries in partnership with an AI vendor.

  • Analyze insights collaborating with product, engineering, and research to ensure AI experiences meet user needs and business objectives.

  • Build scalable conversation frameworks by designing reusable templates, playbooks, and guidelines for consistent, high-quality AI interactions.

  • Advocate for users by championing clarity, empathy, and accessibility in every interaction to create trustworthy and enjoyable AI experiences taking into account language and cultural nuances.

  • Organize and lead research, tests, and establish and manage feedback loops to improve human-AI interactions.

  • Influence AI strategy by providing actionable recommendations for AI deployment, feature development, and roadmap planning.

Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree

  • 6+ years of experience in conversation design, voice UX, with a portfolio demonstrating depth in both chat and voice.

  • Hands-on experience designing for generative or agentic AI. Strong understanding of how LLM-driven systems differ from rule-based systems, including capabilities, limitations, ambiguity, and failure modes..

  • Designed conversational systems at global scale. Comfortable balancing guided and open-ended interactions, handling unexpected input, and defining escalation or routing logic.

  • Track record of creating reusable design assets such as pattern libraries, behavioral guidelines, or interaction frameworks.

  • Experience partnering closely with engineering and product, translating design intent into clear specifications, and iterating through testing, A/B experimentation, and prompt refinement.

  • Proficiency with conversation design and prototyping tools.

  • Comfortable working directly with conversation data, logs, and prompt iteration workflows.

  • Background in linguistics, HCI, cognitive science, or a related field is a plus.

  • Experience presenting to executive audiences is a plus.

  • Experience with a customer support virtual agent is a plus

  • Desired qualities: leadership, independent, self-starter, innovative thinking, curious, action oriented, ability to drive improvements, strong relationship builder, superior communication skills, highly adaptable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment

The Multimedia Strategist will focus on producing high-quality video content that brings our brand stories and campaigns to life. This role involves end-to-end video production—from concept development and filming to editing and post-production—alongside photography and design support. The ideal candidate is a creative visual storyteller who combines technical expertise, strategic thinking, and attention to detail to deliver multimedia materials that strengthen our marketing and communication efforts.

HMO

13th month

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the conceptualization, production, and editing of multimedia content, with a primary focus on video production.
  • Capture and produce both short-form content (social media clips, reels, teasers) and long-form productions (corporate videos, event highlights, interviews, documentaries).
  • Plan, direct, and execute video and photo shoots, ensuring brand consistency and professional quality.
  • Manage all stages of the video production process, including storyboarding, script coordination, filming, editing, and post-production.
  • Edit and retouch photos to ensure consistent visual identity across all materials.
  • Design supporting graphics and marketing materials for digital and print platforms (social media, posters, presentations, etc.).

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Multimedia Arts, Film, Communication, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a multimedia designer or videographer with a strong portfolio emphasizing video production.
  • Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and After Effects.
  • Skilled in photography and image editing using Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop.
  • Working knowledge of graphic design software, including Adobe Illustrator and InDesign.
  • Strong grasp of visual storytelling, composition, cinematography, and editing across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Experience in creating marketing collaterals and social media assets.
  • Highly creative with excellent attention to detail, organization, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
  • Experience with live streaming and virtual event production.
  • Background in both short-form and long-form video projects.
  • Familiarity with motion graphics and basic animation.
  • Experience producing content for corporate, lifestyle, and campaign-based platforms.
